entities.summary: Jean-Claude Robert Guy Hollerich is a Luxembourgish Catholic prelate who has served as Archbishop of Luxembourg since 2011. He was the president of the Commission of the Bishops' Conferences of the European Union (COMECE) from March 2018 to 2023. He is a member of the Jesuits. Jean-Claude Hollerich was a writers & intellectuals from Differdange (b. 1958-08-09, Differdange). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
